review.shorterRoute: The existing originalPadicHeckeEigencharacter already accepts any prescribed Fourier-field embedding. Apply it directly to the existing explicit continuous rank-two Tate realization and native coefficient-change maps. Reuse the actual finite Tate module and existing stable-lattice/residual construction, keeping the supplied embedding rather than using an existential wrapper that forgets it. The previous pointwise Frobenius and inertia consumers then apply unchanged. No new Hecke algebra, Tate geometry, coefficient representation or lattice theory is built. IntegralCoefficientEmbedding was reviewed for the next prescribed-reduction step: it constructs a place from an embedding, so it does not by itself supply an embedding compatible with a specified reduction. The native rational completion/p-adic equivalence used in RationalPrimeOriginalResidueCard is a candidate for the required completion route, not yet claimed consumed here.
